controls.name: Environmental Management System Scope
controls.description: Define the activities, services, locations and boundaries covered by the EMS.

controls.name: Environmental Policy
controls.description: Set commitments for environmental protection, compliance, objectives and improvement.

controls.name: Environmental Aspects and Impacts Register
controls.description: Identify lifecycle-aware environmental aspects and impacts, including climate, resource use, pollution, biodiversity, ecosystems and land use where relevant, and evaluate significance.

controls.name: Environmental Compliance Obligations Register
controls.description: Maintain applicable environmental legal, permit, contractual and other obligations.

controls.name: Environmental Compliance Evaluation Procedure and Record
controls.description: Evaluate fulfilment of environmental compliance obligations and retain evidence.

controls.name: Environmental Objectives and Action Programme
controls.description: Set measurable environmental objectives, actions, owners, resources and evaluation methods.

controls.name: Environmental Operational Control Procedure
controls.description: Control significant aspects, obligations and environmental risks in operations and suppliers.

controls.name: Waste and Resource Management Register
controls.description: Track material waste streams, handling, providers, obligations and reduction opportunities.

controls.name: Energy, Water and Resource Monitoring Register
controls.description: Monitor material resource use, trends, abnormal consumption and improvement opportunities.

controls.name: Environmental Emissions and Discharges Register
controls.description: Record material emissions, discharges, monitoring, limits and evidence where relevant.

controls.name: Environmental Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan
controls.description: Prepare for, respond to and test foreseeable environmental emergency situations.

controls.name: Environmental Incident and Near-Miss Register
controls.description: Record incidents, near misses, impacts, notifications, causes and corrective actions.

controls.name: Supplier and Contractor Environmental Assessment
controls.description: Apply proportionate environmental requirements to relevant suppliers and contractors.

controls.name: Lifecycle and Sustainable Procurement Assessment
controls.description: Consider material upstream and downstream environmental impacts and organisational influence.

controls.name: Environmental Monitoring and Measurement Plan
controls.description: Define environmental indicators, methods, frequency, criteria and evaluation responsibilities.

controls.name: Environmental Communication Plan
controls.description: Define reliable internal and external environmental communication responsibilities.

controls.name: EMS Internal Audit Checklist and Report
controls.description: Audit EMS implementation, operational controls, compliance evaluation and performance.

controls.name: EMS Management Review Agenda and Minutes
controls.description: Review environmental performance, context, compliance, resources and improvement decisions.

controls.name: Environmental Nonconformity and Corrective Action Form
controls.description: Record correction, cause analysis, corrective action and effectiveness for environmental issues.
